bankruptcy.title: Bankruptcy Portal
bankruptcy.subtitle: Bankruptcy proceedings, administrators and legislation in Croatia
bankruptcy.overview.title: What is Bankruptcy?
bankruptcy.overview.text: Bankruptcy (stečaj) in Croatia is regulated by the Stečajni zakon (NN 71/15, 104/17, 36/22). It is a legal procedure initiated when a debtor becomes insolvent or over-indebted. The goal is to collectively satisfy creditors through liquidation of assets or financial restructuring.
bankruptcy.sections.listingsDesc: Published bankruptcy notices, creditor calls and asset auctions
bankruptcy.sections.administratorsDesc: Licensed bankruptcy administrators and their contact information
bankruptcy.sections.legislationDesc: Stečajni zakon and related EU directives
bankruptcy.process.title: The Bankruptcy Process
bankruptcy.process.step1: 1. Petition — Filed by debtor or creditor with the commercial court
bankruptcy.process.step2: 2. Opening — Court examines solvency; if accepted, bankruptcy is opened
bankruptcy.process.step3: 3. Administrator — Court appoints a bankruptcy administrator (stečajni upravitelj)
bankruptcy.process.step4: 4. Resolution — Assets liquidated or restructuring plan approved by creditors

legalAid.title: Free Legal Aid
legalAid.intro: The Republic of Croatia provides free legal aid (besplatna pravna pomoć) to persons who cannot afford legal representation. The system is governed by the Zakon o besplatnoj pravnoj pomoći (NN 143/13, 98/19).
legalAid.primary.title: Primary Legal Aid
legalAid.primary.desc: General legal information, advice, and assistance filling in forms for administrative and judicial proceedings. Provided free of charge without means testing.
legalAid.secondary.title: Secondary Legal Aid
legalAid.secondary.desc: Full legal representation in court proceedings, including a lawyer appointed by the Croatian Bar Association. Subject to a means test and case merits assessment.
legalAid.eligibility.title: Eligibility
legalAid.eligibility.income: Household income does not exceed the threshold (approx. €441/month per member). Special categories include: victims of domestic violence, asylum seekers, persons with disabilities, and minors.
legalAid.howToApply.title: How to Apply
legalAid.howToApply.step1: 1. Submit application form to your county court (županijski sud) or Ministry of Justice office
legalAid.howToApply.step2: 2. Attach proof of income (employer certificate, social welfare confirmation)
legalAid.howToApply.step3: 3. The court decides within 15 days; approved applicants receive a referral to a licensed lawyer

about.title: About Us
about.intro1: Sudačka mreža (Judicial Network) is a non-profit association that for over twenty years has been collecting, processing, and publishing publicly relevant data from the judicial system of the Republic of Croatia. Our goal is judicial transparency and the accessibility of legal information to all citizens.
about.intro2: The platform offers searchable databases of case law (Supreme Court, High Commercial Court, European Court of Human Rights), a court directory with an interactive jurisdiction map, a directory of court experts and interpreters, bankruptcy estate sale listings, and an overview of relevant legislation.
about.intro3: All services are available free of charge. Registration is only required to access contact details of court professionals.

deadlines.statute.civil: General limitation: 5 years (COA Art. 230). Tort: 3 years subjective, 5 years objective.
deadlines.statute.criminal: Limitation for prosecution: 5–25 years depending on maximum sentence (CC Art. 81).
deadlines.statute.commercial: Commercial contract claims: 3 years (COA Art. 233). General for entrepreneurs: 5 years.
deadlines.statute.administrative: Deadline to bring administrative suit: 30 days from service of final decision (ADA Art. 24).
deadlines.legalBasisCommercial: Civil Procedure Act – application before commercial courts
deadlines.legalBasisAdministrative: General Administrative Procedure Act (NN 47/09) and Administrative Disputes Act (NN 20/10)

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Sudačka mreža ('we', 'our', 'Sudačka mreža') is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy describes how we collect, use and protect your personal data in accordance with Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR) and Croatian data-protection law.
privacy.section1.title: 1. Data We Collect
privacy.section1.p1: We collect the following categories of personal data depending on how you use our platform:
privacy.section1.li1: Account data: name, email address and hashed password on registration
privacy.section1.li2: Usage data: pages visited, searches performed and saved decisions
privacy.section1.li3: Device data: IP address, browser type and operating system
privacy.section1.li4: Contact form data: name, email address and message content
privacy.section2.title: 2. Legal Basis for Processing
privacy.section2.p1: We process your personal data under the following legal bases:
privacy.section2.li1: Contract performance (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR): to provide services to registered users
privacy.section2.li2: Legitimate interests (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR): for platform security and service improvement
privacy.section2.li3: Consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR): for analytics cookies (only with your consent)
privacy.section3.title: 3. Data Retention
privacy.section3.p1: We retain your personal data only as long as necessary for the purpose for which it was collected:
privacy.section3.li1: Account data: duration of the account + 30 days after deletion
privacy.section3.li3: Contact form data: 2 years from receipt
privacy.section4.title: 4. Your Rights
privacy.section4.p1: As a data subject you have the following rights under the GDPR:
privacy.section4.li1: Right of access: you may request a copy of the personal data we hold about you
privacy.section4.li2: Right to rectification: you may request correction of inaccurate data
privacy.section4.li3: Right to erasure ('right to be forgotten'): you may request deletion of data no longer needed
privacy.section4.li4: Right to data portability: you may request your data in a structured, machine-readable format
privacy.section4.li5: Right to object: you may object to processing based on legitimate interests
privacy.section4.p2: Submit requests to: info@sudacka-mreza.hr. We respond within 30 days.
privacy.section5.title: 5. Supervisory Authority — AZOP
privacy.section5.p1: If you believe that processing of your personal data infringes GDPR, you have the right to lodge a complaint with the Croatian Personal Data Protection Agency (AZOP):
privacy.section6.title: 6. Changes to This Policy
privacy.section6.p1: We reserve the right to update this Policy. We will notify you of material changes by email or platform notice at least 14 days before they take effect. Continued use of the platform after that period constitutes acceptance of the updated Policy.

cookies.policySection1.p1: Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website. They allow the site to remember your preferences and improve your experience. Cookies cannot run programs or transmit viruses.
